programme.desc: 'S15/E5 - The Mufon Files'. MUFON is the world's leading organization devoted to the scientific investigation of unidentified aerial phenomena and other unexplained encounters.

programme.title: Secrets Declassified With David...
programme.desc: 'Secrets Declassified With David Duchovny. S2/E3 - Buried Secrets'. The safest place to hide the truth is underground. David Duchovny exposes a clandestine nuclear blast set off deep below Mississippi soil.

programme.title: The Curse Of Oak Island
programme.desc: 'S13/E23 - A Sacred Symbol'. The team makes a find in the Money Pit that offers new evidence of a possible Templar tie to the Oak Island mystery.

programme.title: Secrets In The Dark
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Rituals Of The Hidden Past'. In Neolithic China, the burial site at Jiahu reveals a child's remains marked with peculiar bone modifications. These alterations raise questions about ancient mortuary practices and beliefs.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Fall Of France'. The world had largely ignored the growing threat of Nazism during the late 1930s and now the appeasement of Hitler was about to have terrible consequences.

programme.title: Truthseekers
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Nazca Lines'. The Nazca lines were made by ancient people 2000 years ago and continue to exist without any damages to date. How were they formed? What purpose could they have served?

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S10/E2 - On The Road: Montana Face-Off'. At the New Agrarian School in Bigfork, Montana, three top smiths are tested like never before. After two gruelling challenges, only one will go through to the the finals.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S10/E3 - On The Road: Appalachian Showdown'. At the Clay Spencer Blacksmith shop, three of the forge's best smiths are put through their paces.

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: 'S19/E38 - Picking The Godfather'. The Pacific Northwest is a picking paradise as Mike crashes into the godfather of Italian scooters while Robbie and Jersey nearly drown in a sea of smalls.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S15/E4 - Perm-Anently Fullerton'. All the whales are coming to the big auction in Fullerton... or at least, that's what Barry hears as he takes Dusty under his wing to see what kind of profit he can style.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S15/E5 - I Love Lupe!'. The women outnumber the men in Rosamond, as Dusty and his girlfriend discover vintage TV memorabilia. Danielle and Lisa help Brandi to dig for gold, and what they find gives them pause.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S15/E6 - Etrog, Lupe?'. Lancaster is Ivy's honeypot, so everyone had better watch out or they might get stung. Lisa plans to use the right side of her brain when selecting lockers... or is it the left?

programme.title: Repair Shop Australia
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. The Repair Shop join forces for a restoration of a 1960's Dollhouse for mother and daughter, Michelle and Caitlyn. This heirloom has been treasured by Michelle as a little girl, being hand built just for her.

programme.title: Ultimate Mysteries
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Strange Triangles'. This episode focuses on three triangle stories. Do we now know what the mystery is behind the Bermuda Triangle? Why are their strange sightings at Bridgewater Triangle?

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - Battle Of Britain'. With the fall of France, only Britain stood between Hitler and complete victory in Europe. But German High Command knew that it first had to have mastery of the skies.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - U-Boat Terror'. With the invasion of Britain officially postponed, The Germans looked for another way to knock Britain out of the war. As an island race, Britons depended on its merchant navy to provide war materials.
